pattern_explanation: These look-alike words developed different meanings in each language, so their forms appear similar while their senses diverge. Learners can be misled into choosing the English look-alike instead of the true meaning.
false_friend_warning: False friend trap: the Polish word aktualny looks like the English word 'actual', but it means 'current' or 'up-to-date'. 'Actual' means 'real', so these two must not be matched.
